notes.title: Fix patch has been released.
notes.notes:
Wide screen mode is implemented.
　It can be switched by F5 and F6 keys.
　Fine adjustment of screen position has been changed to F7 and F8 keys.

notes.title: Fix patch has been released.
notes.notes:
・Tutorial implemented (Japanese version)
・Enemy bullets can be destroyed on "harder" difficulty levels.

notes.title: Fix patch released
notes.notes: Adjustment of balance after stage 4 on hard difficulty and above.

notes.title: Patch released to fix
notes.notes:
Added 100,000 remaining aircraft bonus for clearing the final stage.
Stage 4 was expanded.
The main gun of the first equipment of TYPE-3 was changed to a reflective laser.
Adjustment of warning timing

notes.title: Patch released to fix
notes.notes:
TYPE-4's special weapon is now able to pass through walls.
Added warning signs for stage 2, 3, 4, and 7 bosses.
Added shutters on stage 7.
Other minor additions

notes.title: Patch released to fix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused the stage 2 boss to freeze if two cores attached to the front of the boss were broken.
The coordinates for the disappearance of bullets from the ship were changed to the front to prevent running out of bullets, and the enemy durability was adjusted accordingly.
Added maps for Stage 4 and Stage 5 (Arcade mode only)
Changed some ending messages.

notes.title: Patch released to fix
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in which the loop is not released even when the stock is full in stage 6.
Increased the number of stocks required for Stage 6.
Weakened the enemy before the boss in Stage 6.

notes.title: Patch released to fix
notes.notes:
Change the arcade mode.
　Fixed difficulty level to "NORMAL"
　Changed to "on-the-spot resurrection".
　Items in possession are now scattered.
Fixed to return resurrection except Arcade mode and Practice mode.
Tracer button operation can now be selected.

notes.title: Patch released to fix
notes.notes:
TYPE-4 equipment added
Changed the name of the difficulty level
Stage 3 gimmick added, enemy changed, etc.

notes.title: Stage 7 enemy weapons added, bug fixes, etc.
notes.notes:
Added more enemy weapons inside the stage 7 fortress
Fixed character disappearance on demo screen

notes.title: Implemented online ranking function, Bug fixes, and so on.
notes.notes:
Implemented online ranking function.
(Added and modified on Feb. 14, 2022)
some Bug fixes
Slight adjustment of difficulty level.
Added self-destruct function for some bosses (stage 2, 4, 5)
Fixed the display position of points earned.

notes.title: Bug fixes, improvements, etc.
notes.notes:
Lower difficulty (can now destroy indestructible enemies on stage 6)
Made Practice Mode easier to play (revive on the spot, play through stage 1-7, add exclusive ending)
Added Mania Mode (no invincibility when acquiring items)
Fixed a bug (added an effect when the boss is destroyed)
Resurrection on the spot mode can be used after clearing EASY mode.
Changed the stage 1's boss bgm in EASY mode.
Eased the time limit for continue.
Changed the sound effect when getting a rapid-fire item.
Added backgrounds for 8 stage.
